name: grab GRPH intermediate
command: while true; do g=$(ls dumps/run-jfr-38/data/shapes/.*.grph 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$g" ]; then sz1=$(stat -c%s "$g"); sleep 5; sz2=$(stat -c%s "$g" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$sz1" = "$sz2" ] && [ "$sz1" -gt 1000000000 ]; then cp "$g" /home/olowo/dlc-capab.grph && echo "COPIED $g -> /home/olowo/dlc-capab.grph ($sz1 bytes)" && exit 0; fi; fi; sleep 20; done
description: grab GRPH intermediate when extract finishes writing it
